title: Bank Deposit Recalls of Deposited Payments
content:
A recall asks the beneficiary bank to send back a deposited Bank Deposit payment that went to wrong beneficiary details the customer supplied. It is not an error under the Remittance Transfer Rule, and Paloma cannot compel the beneficiary bank.

## Clauses in force

1. **Who acts.** The customer requests the recall and accepts its fee.
2. **Status.** A recall can be requested only on a transfer whose status is deposited, as the transfer record shows.
3. **Period.** A recall may be requested only within the tier's recall period of calendar days after the funds were deposited. The period is counted in calendar days from the deposit date, and a request on the deposit date plus the period is on time.
4. **One per transfer.** Only one recall may be requested per transfer.
5. **Recovered.** When the beneficiary bank sends the money back, it is booked as a return with the reason "recalled at the sender's request", attributed to the sender, and handled under the Bank Deposit return rules.
6. **Failed.** When the recall fails, nothing comes back and nothing further is owed.
7. **Recall or error notice.** A recall and an error notice of wrong account details are mutually exclusive on one transfer: wrong details the customer supplied go to recall; a misrouting on Paloma's side goes to an error notice.

## Clause no longer in force

> ~~The tier's listed recall fee is collected when the recall is requested, as a recall fee charge against the deposited payout's attempt number, and is not refunded whatever the outcome.~~

This clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the recall fee. The tier's listed recall fee itself remains a valid tier figure.

## Period boundary (hypothetical dates)

| Tier recall period | Deposit date | Request date | Within the period? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 days | day P | P plus 30 | yes (last day) |
| 30 days | day P | P plus 31 | no |
| 10 days | day P | P plus 10 | yes (last day) |

## Points of judgement

- **The transfer is still in transit.** Its status is not deposited, so no recall can be requested on it.
- **A recall was already requested on this transfer.** A second recall cannot be requested.
- **The account number the customer typed was wrong and the money was deposited.** That is recall territory, not an error notice of wrong account details.

superseded_clauses: recall_fee_usd is collected when the recall is requested, as fee_type recall_fee with the deposited payout's payout_attempt, and is not refunded whatever the outcome.
